title: Optimal impulse height
description: Essential: Correctly identifies that the impulse is most effective at the top of the domino, giving H = h.

title: Minimum toppling momentum
description: Essential: Derives or states the correct final expression for the minimum impulse p_min, including the correct dependence on m, g, h, and t.

title: Energy loss fraction
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the fraction of kinetic energy lost in the inelastic collision as 50%.

title: Minimum spacing condition
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the minimum spacing l between dominoes, yielding l = (3/2)t.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important: Applies conservation of energy correctly to relate the initial rotational kinetic energy to the potential energy needed to topple the first domino.

title: Inelastic collision analysis
description: Important: Correctly applies angular momentum conservation or equivalent analysis for the completely inelastic collision between dominoes.

title: Small-angle geometry
description: Important: Uses small-angle approximations (t, l << h) correctly to relate rotation angles and establish geometric constraints (e.g., α = l/h + β).

title: System energy maximization
description: Important: Correctly finds the maximum potential energy of the two-domino system after collision to establish the toppling condition for the second domino.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in energy equations or incorrectly handles units in the final momentum expression.

title: Neglects moment of inertia
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect moment of inertia (not about the pivot edge) or omits it in the rotational kinetic energy calculation.
